---
name: Skill bug or skill request
about: A skill misfired, misrouted, produced the wrong output, or you want a new rule/reference/skill
title: "[skill-name] "
labels: skill
---

## Skill name

Which skill (directory under `skills/`), e.g. `impulse-backend`, `impulse-review`.

## Type

- [ ] Bug — a rule fired wrong, didn't fire, or produced the wrong output
- [ ] Request — a new rule, reference, or skill

## Expected rule / behavior

What the skill's description or reference says should happen (quote it),
or the rule you want added and why.

## Actual behavior

What actually happened instead.

## Transcript snippet

Paste the relevant excerpt: your prompt plus the skill's/agent's
response. Redact anything sensitive first — this repo takes no secrets,
including in bug reports.

## Environment

- CLI: Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / Antigravity
- Install method: marketplace / `scripts/install.js` / manual copy
- Mode active (if backend/frontend): blitz / medium / hardcore / none
